policy: Judge the task's own requirements first, independent of availability. The project floor and preference is Devin swe-2-high: it is the minimum permitted default, never an override of a task that needs more. Prefer adequate Devin models in this CLI first; use another CLI only when no adequate Devin option exists. Codex capacity is deliberately conserved for tasks that justify it or for independent checks when Devin is unsuitable. Antigravity (agy) Claude and GPT families are quota-limited until about 2026-10-21; agy Gemini is a separately billed group that may still work - never treat one family's hold as proof the whole tool is dead, and never bypass an observed hold. Claude Code subscription access is disabled by the organization. A tester should run on a different tool than the developer it checks whenever another adequate option remains. Never lower the required capability or effort to fit a free slot: no adequate model means the task waits, with its reason recorded.

devin-swe-2.what: Agentic software-engineering model for development, debugging, review and orchestration; high is the project floor, max for the hardest long-horizon or subtle concurrency/security work
devin-swe-2.not_for: trivial mechanical steps where medium effort suffices, or tasks beyond its maximum tier
examples: implement a feature across several files

devin-gpt-6-astra.what: Highest-intelligence Devin-hosted GPT model for the hardest, most ambiguous or highest-risk tasks
devin-gpt-6-astra.not_for: routine changes where swe-2 or a lower astra tier is sufficient

devin-claude-opus-5.5.what: Devin-hosted Claude Opus model for demanding implementation, debugging and review work
devin-claude-opus-5.5.not_for: small mechanical tasks or work swe-2 handles at floor cost

devin-gpt-6-sol.what: Devin-hosted general-purpose GPT model for ordinary implementation and review work
devin-gpt-6-sol.not_for: the hardest ambiguous tasks (use astra or swe-2 max) or trivial mechanical steps

devin-adaptive.what: Devin's own model routing: the CLI picks the backend; use only when a task explicitly allows provider choice
devin-adaptive.not_for: tasks whose contract names a concrete model, or evidence that must bind a recorded model identity

codex-gpt-6.1-sol.what: Current general-purpose Codex model for complex software work; conserved capacity, spend on tasks that justify it
codex-gpt-6.1-sol.not_for: tiny mechanical tasks or work the Devin floor handles adequately
examples: implement a feature across several files

codex-gpt-6-astra.what: Highest-intelligence Codex model for the hardest, longest, most ambiguous or highest-risk tasks
codex-gpt-6-astra.not_for: routine changes where a smaller model is sufficient

agy.what: The Antigravity CLI's own default model (Gemini family): what an agy session consumes when a task names no model and what a background Orchestrator session runs
agy.not_for: tasks that must bind a recorded concrete model

agy-gemini-3.8-flash.what: Antigravity-hosted Gemini flash model for ordinary implementation and review; billed in its own quota group, independent of agy Claude/GPT
agy-gemini-3.8-flash.not_for: the hardest reasoning tasks or work requiring long uninterrupted quota

agy-gemini-3.1-pro.what: Antigravity-hosted Gemini pro model for harder tasks when its quota group is free
agy-gemini-3.1-pro.not_for: mechanical work or when the group hold is active

agy-claude-opus-4.6-thinking.what: Antigravity-hosted Claude Opus thinking model for hard implementation and review tasks
agy-claude-opus-4.6-thinking.not_for: work while the observed agy Claude/GPT quota hold is active (until about 2026-10-21)

agy-claude-sonnet-4.6.what: Antigravity-hosted Claude Sonnet model for ordinary implementation and review
agy-claude-sonnet-4.6.not_for: work while the observed agy Claude/GPT quota hold is active

agy-gpt-oss-120b.what: Antigravity-hosted open GPT model for contained implementation and review tasks
agy-gpt-oss-120b.not_for: work while the observed agy Claude/GPT quota hold is active

claude-sonnet-5.5.what: Claude Code subscription model for routine implementation, UI work and review; organization subscription access is currently disabled, so it is usually ineligible
claude-sonnet-5.5.not_for: anything while the disabled-access observation holds

claude-opus-5.5.what: Claude Code subscription model for demanding implementation and review; disabled-access observation applies
claude-opus-5.5.not_for: anything while the disabled-access observation holds
